name: airbnb-clone
description: Root helper scripts to run backend + both frontends together during development

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix admin-frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND,ADMIN -c green,cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix admin-frontend"
